### Aristotle on community

Aristotle (384–322 BCE) approaches community within Peripatetic. Aristotle pursued demonstrative science grounded in observation, definition, and causal explanation. His Organon developed syllogistic logic and standards of proof that structured Western reasoning for two millennia. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets community most directly—useful for searches such as “aristotle quotes on community.”
